result.brief: 提出语义优先的运动编解码器，将语义 token 与残差运动学 token 分层解耦，并配套双轴自回归生成器，其潜空间分层设计对视觉/视频 tokenizer 有迁移参考价值。
result.reason: Motion tokenizer with semantic-first latent codec and residual kinematic tokens; tokenizer/latent design may transfer to visual tokenizers, but domain is human motion, not video/visual representation.
